firstNightReminder: One at a time, wake each good Townsfolk, show them the 'This character selected you' card, show the Abdominal token and point to the Abdominal player.
name: Abdominal
ability: Good Townsfolk know you're the Abdominal. Evil wins at dusk if you're dead. You are sober & healthy. [Minimum 1 Outsider per evil]
flavor: I just woke up one day, and there it was. I don't have any idea how it got there.

otherNightReminder: All marked players die. If the Ball o' Death has not yet fully used their ability: Ball o' Death either shows the 'no' head signal, or points to a player. The 1st Townsfolk, Outsider, & Minion choosing them with an ability are marked to die when you next wake.
name: Ball o' Death
ability: Twice per game, at night*, choose a player: the 1st Townsfolk, Outsider, & Minion who choose them with their ability before you next wake die then.
flavor: All staff are reminded again to not ‘play’ with Ball o' Death. There are disastrous consequences both during and after that action. -Scientific Director “Hex”

name: Contestant
ability: Once per day*, the Storyteller's narrations will subtly contain a hint (arbitrary without this ability.)
flavor: Contestants, are you ready? No? Begone then!

otherNightReminder: If the Living Drawing made their ability today: Wake all Minions, show them the 'This character selected you' card, the Living Drawing's token, and their drawing. If the Living Drawing's ability causes them to wake tonight: Wake the Living Drawing and run their ability.
name: Living Drawing
ability: Once per game, draw your ability (you learn what it is). Minions sees this drawing & if 1 publicly guesses what your ability does, your team loses.
flavor: 𖨆

name: Red Sea Stone
ability: Between each night's end, learn & gain an off-script official Townsfolk's ability, but if an evil died previously, you are drunk.
flavor: מעבר לאש ותימרות העשן, כשמסתכלים על המתרחש בארץ, רואים החרבות של ערכי חיים בסיסים. למשל, לדונם אדמה ניתן ערך גבוה יותר מערך חיי האדם החיים עליו. או שמירה על מצבה המיוחסת לדמות מיתולוגית חשובה יותר משמירה על השומרים. למתבונן מרחוק זה נראה כנטול שמץ של הגיון. ואלו החיים בתוך המערבולת לא רואים את האבסורדיות שנוצרה עקב התעוותות ערכי היסוד.

firstNightReminder: Show the Prognosticator the prophecy.
otherNightReminder: If the Prognosticator's prophecy was fulfilled: Choose a Minion not protected from dying tonight. That player dies.
name: Prognosticator
ability: You start knowing a prophecy. If fulfilled, a Minion dies tonight.
flavor: An all-star collection of the greatest super-stories ever published!

firstNightReminder: If the Multitools's wish requires actions at night, run these.
otherNightReminder: If the Multitools's wish requires actions at night, run these.
name: Multitool
ability: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it comes with an ironic price (you know what).
flavor: Hmm, what say... what say... Screwdriver? No. Jackhammer? Hmm, not that either... Rocket-shoes? Nah, too corny... A-ha, I got it! You can never go wrong with a spring-loaded boxing glove.

name: Living Gun
ability: Good players you publicly refer to might die or be executed today, even if for some reason they could not.
flavor: Oh! Did you hear that? Sounded like death! Someone died... Something to that effect. Tend to hear that a lot around here. Now that I think about it... The whole place just... echoes with death!

firstNightReminder: The Eyepod chooses a player.
otherNightReminder: Give the head signal (nod yes, shake no) for whether they were chosen by an ability, but you may choose to give false results if the target is a Minion. The Eyepod chooses a player.
name: Eyepod
ability: Each night, choose a player: when you next wake, learn if they were chosen by an ability. This info is arbitrary if a Minion was chosen. [+0 or +1 Eyepod]
flavor: They’re all-seeing but see nothing but us. Isn’t that funny? -Junior Researcher Jefferson

firstNightReminder: Point to two players, draw/move your finger across all players inbetween them, and give the head signal (nod yes, shake no) for whether there is an even number of evil players inbetween the two players you pointed at (including them).
name: "3-D" Specs
ability: You start knowing if an even number of evil players are on the half opposite from you.
flavor: Not everything needs to be three-dimensional, especially when the third dimension is so violent.

otherNightReminder: If the Sauelsuesor nominated someone besides themselves today: Nod 'yes' or shake head 'no' for whether the nominated is Minion, and if you did nod 'yes', show that Minion's character token. Remove the 'Stargazed' marker, if any.
name: Sauelsuesor
ability: If you nominated a player today (not yourself), tonight, learn if they are a Minion, and if so, what Minion they are.
flavor: I am too big, and you are too small. There is a sea of nothing and islands of light. I am their shore. To you come the monsters. The pounding fists of void. The longing gods beyond our knowledge. I am the lookout. I see the ripples in their wake. You want me to pledge my sight-know to you, only to you, so you, only you, can be greater. Even if you find, restrain, defend. You want me to be yours. That is not why I am here. There are others. Others I assist. Others I warn. Others beyond your thin walls of grey, dry paste-rock. Others beyond the reach of your weary satellites. Others beyond the home, our home. Others I know. Others I love. Others you won't care for. Others that came before. And, over all, others beyond the little walls of rules and bone and laws and flesh and memories and oaths you build around yourselves until you don't even remember them. Others I love. Dearly. And yet, only my brother is an equal to me.

firstNightReminder: The Architect points to two players. Players choosing the 1st target with their ability are instead redirected choose the 2nd tonight unless this action would cause the game would end.
otherNightReminder: The Architect points to two players. Players choosing the 1st target with their ability are instead redirected choose the 2nd tonight unless this action would cause the game would end.
name: Architect
ability: Each night, choose 2 players (not yourself): tonight, abilities choosing the 1st instead go the 2nd unless the game would end.
flavor: Let’s ensure Site-19 never sees this thing, that’d be the disaster to cause the most logical XK-Class. -Security Lt.“Messer”

firstNightReminder: If the Tunisian has not yet fully used their ability: the Tunisian either shows the 'no' head signal, or points to a player not themself. The latest chosen player is drunk if they're a Outsider or Minion & is protected at night if they're on the same team as the Tunisian.
otherNightReminder: If the Tunisian has not yet fully used their ability: the Tunisian either shows the 'no' head signal, or points to a player not themself. The latest chosen player is drunk if they're a Outsider or Minion & is protected at night if they're on the same team as the Tunisian.
name: Tunisian
ability: Twice per game, choose a player (not yourself): the latest chosen is drunk if Outsider or Minion & cannot die at night if allied.
flavor: يبدو أنك تُعاني. استسلم، سينتهي كل شيء قريبًا!

firstNightReminder: The Neglected points to a player not themself. Mark that player 'Invisible'.
otherNightReminder: The previous chosen player is relieved of your effects. The Neglected points to a player not themself. Mark that player 'Invisible'.
name: Neglected
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): the 1st other player choosing them with their ability tonight is drunk until dusk.
flavor: Now you see me...

otherNightReminder: The previously protected player is no longer protected. If the Panacea has not yet fully used their ability: the Panacea either shows the 'no' head signal, or points to a player. Mark that player 'Ultra-Safe'.
name: Panacea
ability: Twice per game, at night, choose a player: they are safe from everything until dusk.
flavor: A panacea is something we’re in dire need of. Find out how to make more of these immediately. -O5-4

name: Basement Cat
ability: Other Townsfolk keep their ability until dusk (or think they do otherwise.)
flavor: Meoww meow meow meowwwwwww...

firstNightReminder: The Peacemonger chooses a player. If a teammate is chosen, mark that player 'Chosen'.
otherNightReminder: The Peacemonger chooses a player. If a teammate is chosen, mark that player 'Chosen'. If no one is dieing tonight and the Peacemonger isn't marked with 'No ability': mark the Peacemonger with 'Peacetime'.
name: Peacemonger
ability: Each night, choose a player. The 1st time no one died tonight*, you & all chosen teammates are safe from everything until dusk.
flavor: This content feeling is nice and all, but the doves might be a problem.

name: Desire Reader
ability: Each day, privately choose a player: learn a trait they share with the previous player. You are sober & healthy only if they are.
flavor: See foe's remaining HP. Press for secrets!

name: MAN EGG™
ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller to gain the ability your team needs (learn what it is).
flavor: "The longer you wait, the stronger it is!™" -MAN EGG

firstNightReminder: The Hangman chooses a new letter. Show the hand signal for the number (0, 1, 2, etc.) of evil players who have at-least 1 of that letter in their character's name. If it's 0 in regards to Minions specifically, the Hangman is drunk.
otherNightReminder: The Hangman chooses a new letter. Show the hand signal for the number (0, 1, 2, etc.) of evil players who have at-least 1 of that letter in their character's name. If it's 0 in regards to Minions specifically, the Hangman is drunk.
name: Hangman
ability: You can't die at night. Each night, choose a unique letter: learn how many evil's names have it. If 0 for Minions, you are drunk.
flavor: How's it hangin'?

otherNightReminder: If the Revenant died tonight: point your finger horizontally clockwise, and show the character token of the closest living player in that direction, then repeat that action for anti-clockwise.
name: Revenant
ability: If you die at night, learn your alive resident neighbour's characters.
flavor: 'We must declare human death a Keter SCP,' she demanded, 'and contain it at any cost.'

firstNightReminder: The Navigator points to a player; give the head signal (nod yes, shake no) for whether that player is a Minion or not.
otherNightReminder: The Navigator points to a player; give the head signal (nod yes, shake no) for whether that player is a Minion or not.
name: Navigator
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): you learn if they are a Minion. Characters marked on the script give reversed info.
flavor: Woah, look at that baby spin. It's... spinning really fast... ... Do you think it's going to expl-

otherNightReminder: If the Trilḗnē died tonight: the Trilḗnē points to a player. That player dies if they was the killer.
name: Trilḗnē
ability: If you die at night, choose 2 players: your chosen killer dies, even if for some reason they could not.
flavor: *RING-RING* Hello, operator? I think my... I- your... yourrr refrid- reg- refrigd-... err... Uh... I... Uhhhmmmmmmm... ... ...Is your oven running?

firstNightReminder: Point to three players, one of which is a Townsfolk.
name: Provenance
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 3 players is a Townsfolk. If they would die, they don't, then you're drunk.
flavor: I will protect for as long as you my kin. My spawn. My flame. Is that not what bonds and family are about? Is that not what life is about? Cherish everyday like it is a gift. Cherish everyday because it is my gift. You are safe here. You are safe now. Goodnight.

otherNightReminder: The Skynet Agent points to a player. If they point to the Minion marked on the script, that player dies.
name: Skynet Agent
ability: Each night*, choose a living player: if the Minion marked on the script is chosen, they lose their ability & die. [That marked minion is in-play]
flavor: Y'know, I am quite content being a Silver Bullet hunter. It's not like its every once in a while you get to bag a Werewolf on a Christmas morning.

name: Hammer Down
ability: On your 1st day, state your conditions. Whilst true, if a teammate was to die during the day, they don't & you're drunk.
flavor: 62 alarms. All teams respond, code 3. All units BOL for 243 suspect. All units return to code 12. 243 assault on Protection Team. 10-0, begin scanning.

otherNightReminder: If a player is marked 'hexed': they die. If the GOC Physics has not yet fully used their ability: The GOC Physics shows a 'no' head signal, or shows a 'yes' head signal. If the GOC Physics showed a 'yes' head signal, mark them 'Trap set'.
name: GOC Physics
ability: Twice per game, at night*, you may be safe from the Demon & the 1st non-Demon to choose you until tomorrow is drunk then dies.
flavor: Fuckin' dieeeeee....

otherNightReminder: The Pinky points to a player, and a character on their sheet. If correct, that player dies (unless it causes the immediate end of the game).
name: Pinky
ability: Each night*, choose a player and a character: if correct, they die & you are drunk (unless the game ends.)
flavor: What's better than a conga line? A dead one!

firstNightReminder: Show the Premonious their fate.
name: Premonious
ability: You start knowing how you'll die. If you avoid your fate, 1 player dies at any time.
flavor: A moment to gather my thoughts, please. ... Alright, let's do this.

otherNightReminder: If it is the 3rd night and the World-Hopper is not marked 'Disarmed', replace the evil team with characters of your choice, then wake the relevant Minions and/or Demon and show them the 'You are' card and the relevant character tokens. Wake the World-Hopper, even if they're dead. Show them all evil player's new character tokens, but if they're dead, also show a different character token before or after.
name: World-Hopper
ability: On the 3rd night, the evil players become off script official characters. You learn which 1s (if alive) or 1 of 2 (if dead).
flavor: Yeah, so... that agent assigned to escort me to my chambers... he's uhh... kinda... gone... forever. Oops.

name: Fishhead
ability: On night (Max Outsiders + 1 - X), Townsfolk abilities yield false info until dusk. You're sober & healthy. [X Outsiders]
flavor: God hates me.

firstNightReminder: Wake a living Minion, show them the 'This character selected you' token, then the Loyal Servant token. That player either nods their head yes or shakes their head no. If they nodded their head yes, swap the Loyal Servant and that Minion's characters and make the Loyal Servant evil, wake the Loyal Servant to inform them of their new character and alignment.
otherNightReminder: Wake a living Minion, show them the 'This character selected you' token, then the Loyal Servant token. That player either nods their head yes or shakes their head no. If they nodded their head yes, swap the Loyal Servant and that Minion's characters and make the Loyal Servant evil, wake the Loyal Servant to inform them of their new character and alignment.
name: Loyal Servant
ability: Each night, if good, 1 living Minion may 'accept' to swap characters & you become evil. At dusk, this is undone if you both live.
flavor: Forever Mine – S.J.W.

otherNightReminder: If the dead equal or outnumber the living, show them the thumbs up good signal of the thumbs down evil signal accordingly to their alignment, then point to a player on their team.
name: Shoe-In
ability: The 1st time the dead equal or outnumber the living, you join the losing team & learn 1 teammate.
flavor: Must... enter... ocean... must... enter... ocean... going for... schwim...

otherNightReminder: If the Laughster was not funny today: Choose a player not protected from dying tonight. That player might die.
name: Laughster
ability: If you weren't funny today, tonight, a player might die. During the day, you die if & only if you are exceptionally funny.
flavor: Get up, you worthless sack of shit... consider this a friendly reminder: GET WITH THE FUCKING PROGRAM.

otherNightReminder: If the Immaterial is marked 'Dodging': Choose a player not protected from dying tonight. That player dies.
name: Immaterial
ability: If anything bad happens to you, it might be on a living neighbour instead. If executed, you might live, and a player dies tonight.
flavor: Who? Oh right, me! Where? Oh right, here! Haha... ha... If you don't mind me asking, but when...

otherNightReminder: If the evil player's wish requires action at night, run these.
name: Wholesale
ability: The 1st (& only) time an evil player chooses to discard their vote token (secretly), they can make a wish, even if you're dead.
flavor: I looked up in the sky last night and all the stars were shining bright, I wished I may and I wished I might just have the wish I wished last night.

otherNightReminder: Show them the thumbs up good signal or the thumbs down evil signal accordingly, even if they're dead.
name: C-Insurgency
ability: If a player causes or attempts something bad to happen to you, your alignment becomes that opposing them (unless killed).
flavor: Wow, thank you for attempting to discharge your weapon in front of your superior and commanding officer. I'll be sure to amend this piece of fine history on my auto-biography and on your obituary, jackass.

firstNightReminder: Show the Duende their question.
otherNightReminder: You may show the Duende their question if it can be answered tonight. The Duende shows the signals needed to answer it. If correct, show them the 'You Are' card, a thumbs down, and then the Grimoire for as long as they need.
name: Duende
ability: You start knowing a question. Each day or night*, privately answer it: if correct, you see the Grimoire & turn evil.
flavor:
> wife pregnant for 8 months
> her water breaks, rush her to hospital
> she goes into intensive labour & passes away due to complications
> doctor hands me what came out of womb
> 2 gold Örtugs, a dead chicken, and 1 I.O.U
> fucking duendes

name: Living Room
ability: You become a Storyteller, but you're still evil. You cannot make players learn themselves or be subjective for abilities.

firstNightReminder: Show the Orchestrator their quest.
otherNightReminder: If the Orchestrator has completed their quest: Wake them and show them the 'You are' card and the relevant Demon character token. Wake 1 good player, show them the 'This character selected you' card, show the Orchestrator token and show them a slight part of the quest.
name: Orchestrator
ability: You start with a quest. If completed, you become a not-in-play Demon (all learn which) & 1 good player learns part of it.
flavor: Dance with me, just dance! We will sing and serenade until the stars align with our beliefs and wishes. We will wash this cursed blood away from us into this wretched parchment, and celebrate our joyous rebirth into new and free lives. Just come, take my hand. What's the worst that can happen?

firstNightReminder: Show the Pipe Maze their rule.
name: Pipe Maze
ability: If a player is executed, it's redirected to another based on a rule (you start knowing it), if it can (unless it ends the game).
flavor: You will die here... this place will be your grave. You will be contained here forever... and I will live...

name: Missing No.
ability: Marked abilities register falsely & yield false info (except choosing). You & the Demon are safe from marked non-Demon abilities.
flavor: Every school child knows that 2 plus 2 is 4. The solid mathematical certainty of numerical order and value is the basis for all logic-based systems. We know that after 2 comes 3 and after 3 comes 4. What this formula proves is that we missed a number somewhere. Imagine if all our technology was based on the belief that after 4 came 6. We simply didn't know or conceive of 5. That is, in essence, what this formula proves—we missed a number. -Physics & Mathematical Scientist Prof. Hutchinson

firstNightReminder: The [unknown] points to a player. That player is voided and might not register as nothing to other player's abilities.
otherNightReminder: The previously voided player is no longer voided. The [unknown] points to a player. That player is voided and might not register as nothing to other player's abilities.
name: [unknown]
ability: Each night, choose a player (different from last night): they (until dusk) & you might register as nothing to player abilities.
flavor: i forgor 💀

otherNightReminder: The previously chosen player dies. For each non-Townsfolk teammate that died since you last woke: the Infernal points to a player. That player dies the next night.
name: Infernal
ability: For each non-Townsfolk teammate (or yourself) that died since last night, choose a player tonight: they die the next night.
flavor: Pay what you owe... pay what you owe... pay what you owe...

otherNightReminder: If a marked player was executed today whilst not being mad they are a marked character & the Misanthrope has not yet made a player evil: Point to the marked player for the Misanthrope, and wake the marked player to show them the 'You are' card and the thumbs down evil signal.
name: Misanthrope
ability: If an executee is marked but wasn't mad about it: they become evil (once), learn them, & the next living executee's team loses.
flavor: HUMAN. LISTEN CAREFULLY. THEY HURT YOU. YOU ARE BETRAYED. I CAN FIX THAT. JOIN ME. AND I WILL HURT THEM.

otherNightReminder: If a player chose the Shy Guy with their ability the previous night: Point to each player that did, the Shy Guy points to one of them. That player dies.
name: Shy Guy
ability: Each night*, choose a player who chose you with their ability since yesterday: they die. You might register as the Demon.

otherNightReminder: If the Peanut has not yet fully used their ability: the Peanut either shows the 'no' head signal, or points to a player. If the Peanut was not chosen by an ability last night, that player dies.
name: Peanut
ability: Twice per game, at night after the 2nd, choose a player: unless a player chose you since yesterday, they die, no matter what.
flavor: Drr drr drr

firstNightReminder: Wake the player whose token was changed to the Lumenancer in the Grimoire, show them the 'You Are' card, the Lumenancer, and a thumbs down. Point your finger horizontally in the chosen direction.
name: Lumenancer
ability: Players between you & the Demon might register falsely to good players (you learn the direction). [You're 3 to 5 steps from them]
flavor: Smile, honey. Your corpse will look divine under this shine. Let me just fix this lighting angle just right, and done!

otherNightReminder: If all good players are infected with the Clockwork Virus: Announce this, and that from now on, an evil player must be killed each day, or the evil team wins.
name: Clockwork Virus
ability: This spreads by choosing. If all living are infected, all learn this & evil must die today, or evil wins. [+1 Outsider with this]
flavor: loneliness + alienation + fear = clockwork. clockwork + despair + self-worth ÷ mockery = clockwork. clockwork ÷ condemnation ÷ misunderstanding ⋅ guilt = clockwork. clockwork ⋅ shame ⋅ failure ⋅ judgment n=y where y=hope and n=folly, love=lies, life=death, self=clockwork

name: "God"
ability: Whomever threatens to reach the Demon's identity might have something bad happen to them (max 1 poison/misinfo).
flavor: I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me. I wish for all of my children to p̶r̶o̶s̶p̶e̶r DIE. For the light of my will to grant them l̶i̶f̶e DEATH. I hope they are all well off i̶n̶ ̶t̶r̶a̶n̶q̶u̶i̶l̶i̶t̶y DEAD, and a happy  r̶e̶j̶u̶v̶e̶n̶a̶t̶i̶o̶n̶ ̶o̶f̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶m̶i̶n̶d̶ ̶&̶ ̶s̶o̶u̶l HOPE YOU'RE DYING.

firstNightReminder: Wake the player whose token was changed to the Caruncula in the Grim, show them the 'You Are' card, the Caruncula, and a thumbs down.
name: Caruncula
ability: Your Townsfolk neighbours are poisoned & if you are chosen by an ability, they might instead. [You are the farthest from evil]
flavor: I just saw it- there! Look, I just... swear I... saw... nevermind. It was only a false alarm, all derived from my own lack of sleep- THERE IT IS AGAIN!

firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon, show them the 'This character selected you' card, show the Umbilical's token and the character token of the 2nd Demon.
name: Umbilical
ability: The Demon has a 2nd Demon ability (they know which), but cannot kill with it. You might register falsely to marked characters.
flavor: Are you my mommy?

firstNightReminder: Wake the current holder of the Tooth, show them the 'This character selected you' card, show the Tooth Fairy's token, then procure the tooth for them.  They either show the 'no' head signal, or point to a player. The chosen player now holds the tooth and is now marked 'Tooth'. Wake the chosen player, show them the 'This character selected you' token, the Tooth Fairy's token, then point to the previous holder and procure the tooth for them.
otherNightReminder: Wake the current holder of the Tooth even if the Tooth Fairy isn't currently alive, show them the 'This character selected you' card, show the Tooth Fairy's token, then procure the tooth. They either show the 'no' head signal, or point to a player. The chosen player now holds the tooth and is now marked 'Tooth'. Wake the chosen player, show them the 'This character selected you' token, the Tooth Fairy's token, then point to the previous holder and procure the tooth for them. If the Tooth Fairy is in-play and Tooth has been held by a dead good player since then on an other instance: Choose a player not protected from dying tonight. That player dies.
name: Tooth Fairy
ability: 1 player has a tooth, even if not in-play. Each night, holders can pass it; every 2nd time a good holder is dead, a player dies.
flavor: Teeth, teeth, teeth! Gums, gums, gums! Bleed, bleed, bleed! Splash, splash, splash! We love teeth! Teeth, teeth, teeth!

otherNightReminder: The Antipath either shows the 'no' head signal, or points to a player. If the Demon, the Antipath dies, otherwise, that player dies.
name: Antipath
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: if the Demon, you die, otherwise, they die. If you'd die, you might not. Not in team info.
flavor: At the end of the day, the Foundation's gotta eat some babies to save the world. That's just the facts.

firstNightReminder: Show the 1 finger symbol if the Disruptor's information ability will act on odd-numbered nights, or the 2 finger symbol if the Disruptor's information ability will act on even-numbered nights.
name: Disruptor
ability: Each odd/even (you know which) day & night, Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Non-info abilities might register you falsely.
flavor: Wild MISSINGNO appeared!

otherNightReminder: The Atañip points to a player. If that player is a marked character: That player is poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies.
name: Atañip
ability: Each night*, choose a player: a marked player, if chosen, is poisoned & dies next night. If you're executed, you might not die.
flavor: Another child broken in half today! 🥳

firstNightReminder: The Recursion points to up to █ (which is publicly revealed before the tokens are finalized and put into the bag) players, shows the 'yes' head signal, then signals either finger signals, characters on the script, other players, head nods, thumbs up or down, and any other type of ability target, or a combination of any. The information yielded by their abilities is replaced with yours where its applicable to the information they'd normally get from their ability.
otherNightReminder: The Recursion points to up to █ (which is publicly revealed before the tokens are finalized and put into the bag) players, shows the 'yes' head signal, then signals either finger signals, characters on the script, other players, head nods, thumbs up or down, and any other type of ability target, or a combination of any. The information yielded by their abilities is replaced with yours where its applicable to the information they'd normally get from their ability.
name: Recursion
ability: Each night, choose up to █ players (different to last night) & information: it replaces their ability's info until dusk if possible. [█ is known before setup]
flavor: The end is never the end is never the end is never the end is never the end is never the end is never the end is never the end is never...

firstNightReminder: Show a good player their riddle.
otherNightReminder: Show a good player their riddle.
name: Wallbehind
ability: Each night, a good player gets a riddle. If today's answer wasn't correct & a living evil is executed, they only register as dead.
flavor: Who?

otherNightReminder: If the Prosecutor has not yet fully used their ability: the Prosecutor either shows the 'no' head signal, or points to a player, and a character on their sheet. If correct, that player dies.
name: Prosecutor
ability: Thrice per game, choose a player & guess their character: If correct, they die, even if some reason, they could not.
flavor: SIC SEMPER TYRANNIS. I never miss my mark. Abdicate and you will live.

firstNightReminder: If the Skin-Peeler has not yet used their ability: The Skin-Peeler either shows the 'no' head signal, or the 'yes' head signal.
otherNightReminder: If the Skin-Peeler used their ability yesterday, deaths are no longer arbitrary. If the Skin-Peeler has not yet used their ability: The Skin-Peeler either shows the 'no' head signal, or the 'yes' head signal.
name: Skin-Peeler
ability: Once per game, at night, you may choose to become the Demon & have deaths be arbitrary until tomorrow (you have some control).
flavor: You can't save your skin, but I can!

firstNightReminder: Wake a good player - up from bed! Show them the Horseman's character token (they have their head!)
otherNightReminder: The Horseman points to a player, scouring where their head lies. If correct, a player that can encounter death tonight dies!
name: Horseman!
ability: Each night*, a player lays dead if you guess who has your head. They know this dread, & their madness might turn true instead!
attribution: Ability spawned o' bewitch: The creator of swag, @legitch. Art of sorrows and woe: starlight travellers @harryandco.
flavor: Ichabod Crane, you old curr! Thought you could escape my wrath without deter? My sword breathes a deadly sheen, as it edges for your neck on this Halloween. I cast my curse and throw my eyes, yet you bite your thumb at me in surprise? Does nursery cries and limericks not mellow, or has misery acquaint you with strange bedfellows? Avast ye belayment, I've grown a-bore - cry 'Havoc!'; let slip the dogs of war! You protest my presence, and yet here I stand. 'You repent your sins just now?', what a man! Be still by plea, I've seen worse: a pound of flesh for gold, and a kingdom for a horse.

firstNightReminder: Show the Grimoire to the Shadoo for as long as they need, they point to a player. The next good player that player chooses with their ability or nominates dies when they next wake.
otherNightReminder: Those marked to die, die. Show the Grimoire to the Shadoo for as long as they need, they point to a player. The next good player that player chooses with their ability or nominates dies when they next wake.
name: Shadoo
ability: Each night, see the Grimoire & choose a player: the next good player they choose dies at night*.

otherNightReminder: The Watislujv points to a player. That player dies
name: Watislujv
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You are sober, healthy & cannot die at night. [Character type & team rules can be broken]

firstNightReminder: For each player marked 'Sinner', point to them and show their character token.
otherNightReminder: The Possessre points to a player. That player dies.
name: Possessre
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You know 2-3 players & their characters. If they're executed or killed by good, evil wins.

firstNightReminder: Wake the Pestalgue and show them the token of the good ability they have. Put the Pestalgue back to sleep.
otherNightReminder: The Pestalgue points to a player. That player dies.
name: Pestalgue
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You know & have a good ability. If all Outsiders die, gain another. [+1 Outsider]

otherNightReminder: The Harpodaarkniz points to a player. That player dies.
name: Harpodaarkniz
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If executed by a good player, you don't die unless they guess what Minions are in-play.

name: Abysewhell
ability: From now on, nominations don't occur & the Storyteller asks questions: wrong answers kill, correct 1s kill the winner's choice. Evil only loses when all die.

otherNightReminder: Oldephaz points to a player. That player dies.
name: Oldephaz
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If all good players choose to activate the Femur Breaker, good wins. You cannot die.

name: Cespholopod
ability: Each day, publicly choose a player: they die. You are safe if any Minions live & die otherwise. No team info. [+1 Minion]

firstNightReminder: Announce 'SCP-354 is in play', inform the group of the special ability SCP-354 has this game, and what possible sets Minions can come from. It is recommended you change this announcement to make it more thematic whilst keeping it's contents.
otherNightReminder: If SCP-354's special ability causes them to wake tonight: Wake SCP-354 and run their ability.
name: Bludbaythe
ability: All players know you are in play & what your ability is. For each minion, the Storyteller will give a public hint at any time. [Minions can be from any set]

otherNightReminder: If it is the 3rd night or beyond, the Pyrrite points to half of all living players (maximum of 6). Those players die.
name: Pyrrite
ability: Each night after the 2nd, choose half of all living players (max 6): they die.

otherNightReminder: If there is at least 3 dead players: The Peredatore points to a player neighbouring another dead player. Otherwise: The Peredatore points to a player. That player dies.
name: Peredatore
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. With 3+ dead, you can only choose their neighbors, but evils you kill only register as it.

otherNightReminder: If a player with a marked character executed a good player today: swap the Enfekthyte and their character token. Wake each player to inform them of their new role, and show the new Enfekthyte the thumbs down evil signal. The Enfekthyte points to a player. That player dies.
name: Enfekthyte
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If a marked executes & kills a good, they become evil & swap characters with you (once).

otherNightReminder: The Haedlaite points to a player. That player dies.
name: Haedlaite
ability: Each night*, even if dead, choose a player: they die. If a Demon died today, you don't wake tonight. [Another Minion is this]

otherNightReminder: The "Big Red Dog" points to a player. That player dies. If that player isn't protected: Show the character token of that player and place the Stolen marker by that player.
name: "Big Red Dog"
ability: Each night* choose a player: they die. You learn the character, have the ability of & might register as them until the next dawn.

otherNightReminder: The Untisaleep points to a player. That player dies.
name: Untisaleep
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If all living or no good players woke tonight & a good player is executed, evil wins.

otherNightReminder: The Lettucbaken points to a player. If that player is good, they die. Otherwise, choose 1 or 2 good players not protected from dying tonight, they die instead.
name: Lettucbaken
ability: 1 to 2 good players die each night*, prioritizing your choice. Whoever wins, loses, & vice-versa. Minions have no abilities. [No setup effects work]

firstNightReminder: Wake a good player, show them the Skreeblebar's drawing. Wake the Skreeblebar, show them the 'This character selected you' card and the character token of the good player that saw the drawing. If the Skreeblebar gained a new ability from their drawing that acts on the first night: also run it.
otherNightReminder: If the Skreeblebar gained the regular each-night* tactical kill ability: the Skreeblebar points to a player. That player dies. If the Skreeblebar gained a new ability from their drawing that acts on other nights, also run it.
name: Skreeblebar
ability: You start drawing your ability (you learn what it is). 1 good player sees this drawing & you know their character.

otherNightReminder: The Pecks points to a player: that player might die. If it was a Townsfolk, point to a non-Pecks player.
name: Pecks
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they might die. If Townsfolk, learn a non-Pecks. No team info. [Minions are Pecks. -1 Outsider]

firstNightReminder: Inform the ☐☐☒▦⚉☐☒☐☐☐ of their 3 extra bluffs. Point to the 2 marked players.
otherNightReminder: The ☐☐☒▦⚉☐☒☐☐☐ points to a player. That player dies. If the 2 marked players are no longer valid, point to the new 2 marked players.
name: ☐☐☒▦⚉☐☒☐☐☐
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You know 2 good alive players: if the 1st executes the 2nd, evil wins. You get +3 bluffs.
flavor: Nf3 d5 e4 dxe4 Ng5 f5 Bc4 Nh6 Nxh7 Rxh7 Qh5+ Kd7 Qg6 Rh8 Be6+ Kc6 Bxc8+ Qd6 Qe8+ Kb6 Qa4 I WILL RIP YOUR TONGUE OUT.

otherNightReminder: The ▼ points to a player. That player dies.
name: ▼
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [1 to All Minions are from the Trouble Brewing set]

otherNightReminder: Wake the Demon, show them the 'This character selected you' token, then the Eyeceue's token. They point to a player. That player dies unless both there are 2 or less good players alive and an evil player died today.
name: Eyeceue
ability: A living known Minion 'is the Demon' & chooses a player each night*: they die. If there are ≤2 living good & an evil died today, no good dies tonight. [+1 no-info Minion]

firstNightReminder: Show them the 'You Are' card, and the xX_2662_Xx character token.
name: xX_2662_Xx
ability: You win with good, have a Demon's ability, & cannot kill yourself. If all Minions publicly guess you are 2662 & you're not about to die, evil wins. [+1 Outsider]

otherNightReminder: bzzip.exe points to a player. That player dies.
name: bzzip.exe
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The day & night actions run on a timer that gets progressively smaller over time.

firstNightReminder: For you and each Minion player, wake them, show them their quest.
otherNightReminder: If the O. Horseman or a Minion completed their quest and transformed into their Demon: Announce which Demon is now in-play.
name: O. Horseman
ability: You & all Minions have a quest. On completion, that player evolves into their Demon marked on script (you keep your ability) & all players learn which.
flavor: It stopped soon as my flare reached its highest point, and turned. It looked straight down at me, both the horse and the... thing, on its back. It smiled, and for the first time in my life, I felt utter despair and ruin. Calamity stepped foot through the gates of heaven, ready for another world to destroy.

otherNightReminder: This Demon points to a player. That player dies.
name: What Knife?
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. After day 3, you may publicly choose a living player: all other players choose if their team wins or loses.

firstNightReminder: Show a Minion the 'You are' card and a thumbs up good signal.
otherNightReminder: More than likely, you'll choose a player or two, those player(s) dies.
name: Salvation
ability: If you are executed, your team wins. The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins. [1 Minion is good & doesn't get evil info]

otherNightReminder: If the Voidwalker gained an ability today: Wake the Voidwalker and show them the token of the ability they gained. Put the Voidwalker back to sleep.
name: Voidwalker
ability: You gain the vote tokens others use & might gain the abilities (once, you learn what) others lose.

otherNightReminder: The Two-Spirit points to a player. Wake the player and show them the 'You are' card and the relevant character token. If the character is off-script, announce that the Two-Spirit has used their ability and an off-script character was brought in - also note down which specific set they came from.
name: Two-Spirit
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they become a character of the same alignment & all learn what set it's from if it's off-script.

otherNightReminder: The Sugar Rush points at any player. Then, put the Sugar Rush to sleep. Wake the chosen player, show them the 'This character selected you' token, then the Sugar Rush token. That player either nods their head yes or shakes their head no. If they nodded their head yes, you may choose to activate their ability up to thrice when they next wake. That player dies afterwards.
name: Sugar Rush
ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they agree, their ability works twice until tomorrow, then, they die, no matter what.

name: Hanged King
ability: Publicly ask, and you might receive (once per day & all players learn what it is). On your 3rd declined request, you are exiled.

otherNightReminder: Wake a player, show them the 'You are' card and the relevant character token.
name: Encyclopediac
ability: Each night*, a player might become a character you mentioned today that's unhelpful to them.

name: Dissociative
ability: A, if B, choose C1: C2. D. E. The Storyteller chooses who creates which section (B, D, & E optional), they also get the final say.

name: Dr. Bright
ability: If you are mad you were your alignment, something good might happen to your team, and vice-versa.

firstNightReminder: Wake all starting evil players together, allow them to communicate however possible in the current medium. When enough activity has elapsed between these players, put them to sleep.
otherNightReminder: Wake all starting evil players together, allow them to communicate however possible in the current medium. When enough activity has elapsed between these players, put them to sleep.
name: Telepathagion
ability: Each night, the evil team communicates (however possible).

name: Galaxy Sim.
ability: Before the game starts, up to 25% of the script can be changed by a consensus majority of players.

name: Tyranny!
ability: Each day, if no-one is executed, all players publicly choose a coin side, then one is flipped! If the Demon is correct, evil wins.

name: The Gift
ability: Players experiencing any hardships (in-game or in real life) might have something good happen to them or their ability.

name: Dr. Maynard
ability: Before setup, the player designated to be Demon gets the choice of Demons they get to be.

otherNightReminder: If a day kill was delayed: those marked with 'Dead' die or are poisoned if another player is dieing tonight.
name: W's Library
ability: Successful kills after the 1st each night instead poison the victim from now on. Day kills are delayed until night.
